name: Raiden Shogun
notes: An Electro Burst DPS (and, in Hyperbloom, an EM sub-DPS) that scales with ATK. Musou no Hitotachi (401% ATK at level 1, more with Resolve stacks) is her damage, so the damage talent is the Burst; both sources put the Burst first and the Skill second (Game8 reverses them only for the sub-DPS build). The sources agree on 4pc Emblem of Severed Fate for the on-field build (KQM: undisputed best), an ER or ATK% Sands, an ATK% or Electro DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet, with Engulfing Lightning first and Staff of Homa or The Catch behind it; and for Hyperbloom on EM on every slot, Flower of Paradise Lost and Gilded Dreams, with Dragon's Bane first. The card follows the on-field build, since it is the one her goals and weapon list serve; EM is kept as the last option on the Sands and Goblet. Game8 gives no stat goals; the ER goal is KQM's 200-220% for solo Electro (130-190% with another Electro unit), upper end. Atk, CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG goals are left to the role's default.
